items.title: Somalia braces for El Niño floods as millions face risk of hunger
items.description: In Bayahaaw village, on the outskirts of Jowhar in central Somalia, farmers face a difficult choice: plant crops and risk losing them to floodwaters or leave their fields bare and face potential hunger in the coming year. Nuh Adan, a farmer and community leader in Bayahaaw, said flooding caused by breached riverbanks could devastate local agriculture for months. Macawiisley forces from Hiiraan have played a key role in supporting Somali government troops against Al-Shabaab. "We demand the immediate release of the five Italian women detained by the Israeli Defense Forces," Tajani said in Istanbul, where he is taking part in the 4+4 ministerial meeting with his counterparts from France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Egypt. items.description: Yet, behind these crises are millions of people who share deep historical, cultural, economic, and social ties. items.title: Sudan: WFP Strongly Condemns Attack On Trucks In South Kordofan, Killing One Driver
items.description: One driver was killed in the air strike. We extend our deepest condolences to his family, friends and colleagues. The contracted trucks were en route from Dilling to Kadugli and clearly marked as humanitarian vehicles. Additional details regarding the circumstances of the incident, including the extent of the damage to the food cargo, are still being collected. WFP calls for a prompt and impartial investigation into this incident and for those responsible for any violations to be held accountable.
